answer: A concrete approach: chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by making the twenty-first clone cost more than the first twenty combined, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The horizon of work and the signal of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a quartz to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
